CASA Cubes in the City

Andy CASA, UCL East

As part of a future 'Easter' themed  promotion we have produced a short teaser clip around 'cubes in the city'.

The movie was produced using ESRI City Engine, 3D Max and Lumion  - it is also being used as part of our Masters course on Advanced Spatial Analysis and Visualisation to demonstrate how simulation (MassFX) can be combined with procedural city creation and rapid visualisation...

 
Lumion has a few issues with lighting  - there are some errors in the movie above - however for work created and rendered in under 3 hours its worth living with...
